observations: Blue industrial gear box with a central shaft and lifting ring.
Two mounting brackets on the sides.
A label on the side of the housing is visible but the text is illegible.
The shaft appears to be missing its protective cap.
The housing shows some surface rust and wear.

No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The internal gears may be damaged or worn.
risks.proof: A video of the gear box being tested for meshing.

risks.risk: The output shaft may be cracked or broken.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the output shaft and a video of it being rotated.

risks.risk: The internal oil seals may be leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the gear box being filled with oil and running.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the shaft being turned by hand to check for looseness.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
